item.title: Unseasonably warm conditions continue into next week
item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – Cloud coverage increased across the state today as moisture returned to some areas. Isolated showers have been moving through the southern and eastern parts of the state today, with temperatures remaining well above normal. Drier conditions return statewide Sunday, though a few spotty showers may return Monday in far southern New Mexico. [...]

item.title: Late run fuels Longhorns to 79-68 win over Ole Miss, former head coach
item.description: Jordan Pope's 4-point play gave the Longhorns a 69-68 lead with 2:43 remaining, and then Dailyn Swain scored three the hard way with 1:55 left to help fuel the big run. The win puts the Longhorns over .500 in SEC play at 6-5 and 15-9 overall.

item.title: More Americans interested in Bad Bunny Super Bowl show than TPUSA's Kid Rock-headlined alternative
item.description: Bad Bunny will make history on Sunday as the first solo Latin artist to headline a Super Bowl Halftime Show.
